plays.desc_ko: BrokenBlade가 Peyz에게 플래시로 진입했으나 곰덫이 제때 연결되지 않음. Labrov도 플래시로 Peyz를 묶으려 했으나 재탑승이 충분치 않아 Peyz가 BrokenBlade를 처치('pay the piper').
plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade flashes onto Peyz but Beartrap on a Rope doesn't connect in time, and despite Labrov's flash follow-up, Peyz kills BrokenBlade before he can remount.
plays.quote: BROKEN BLADE FLASHING FOR PAYS ... TRAP DOESN'T CONNECT IN TIME ... LRO FLASHES TRYING TO

plays.desc_ko: Caps가 Faker·Oner의 추격을 플래시로 피하고, Peyz 궁·Keria 궁도 버텨 폭발 열매를 이용해 도주. Labrov가 합류해 보호하고 Caps는 비전 광선 이속을 써 결국 빠져나감. Doran은 뒤쪽으로 TP.
plays.desc_en: Caps flashes away from Faker and Oner, survives Ace in the Hole and Final Spark, and uses a Blast Cone and Death Ray's movement speed to escape with Labrov's protection while Doran teleports behind.
plays.quote: CAPS FLASHES AWAY FROM ... CAPS ALMOST FALLS ... Caps continues to run away

plays.desc_ko: 바론이 열린 상태에서 T1이 G2의 귀환을 지연시키려 하던 중 Peyz가 앞으로 나왔다가 쓰러짐. 회고: SkewMond가 Peyz에게 풀 커밋, Labrov 속박 지원, 결국 추격 끝에 Peyz 처치. 이로 인해 T1은 바론을 못 챙김.
plays.desc_en: With Baron up and T1 delaying G2's reset, Peyz steps forward and SkewMond fully commits with Labrov's root support, chasing him down and denying T1 the Baron.
plays.quote: BUT IN GOES PACE AND ... DOWN GOES PACE ... Skan fully commits to pace

plays.desc_ko: 회고에서 같은 교전 중 Doran이 G2 후방 라인으로 파고들어 전열을 무너뜨렸고, 다른 쪽에서 Hans Sama가 죽어가고 있었다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: In the same fight, Doran dives into G2's backline to break their formation while Hans Sama is dying elsewhere.
plays.quote: Dorian has ... gotten into the backline ... him and Hans is dying on the other side

plays.desc_ko: G2가 교전 개시. BrokenBlade가 곰덫으로 진입했다가 즉시 하차, Hans Sama 화살과 클레드 궁은 Oner의 분신에 막힘. SkewMond가 재진입해 Peyz에게 Q3 에어본을 넣었으나 T1이 Peyz의 공간을 지켜줌.
plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade engages with Beartrap on a Rope and is immediately dismounted, Hans Sama's arrow and Kled's ultimate are absorbed by Oner's decoy, and SkewMond re-enters to knock up Peyz, but T1 protects Peyz's space.
plays.quote: broken blade trying to get in with the ... bear tra there. He gets dismounted ... able to block both the enchanted crystal

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 궁(Cyclone)으로 재진입, SkewMond를 묶고, Faker 궁은 합류하지 못해 취소. Peyz가 저체력으로 버티며 BrokenBlade·Hans Sama·SkewMond(수호천사 부활 포함) 등을 차례로 처치해 펜타킬. 리플레이: Doran이 쿨다운 소모를 노리고 진입, 바인딩이 벽 너머 Caps에게 적중, Peyz가 Hans Sama와의 1대1에서 승리.
plays.desc_en: Oner re-engages with Cyclone to lock SkewMond as Faker's ultimate is cancelled, while a low-health Peyz picks off BrokenBlade, Hans Sama and SkewMond through Guardian Angel for a pentakill; Doran baits cooldowns and a binding hits Caps over the wall.
plays.quote: time as Owner comes BACK IN WITH ... WILL NOT SAVE. HE'S GOING FOR THE PENT ... AND PAYS GETS THE PENTILL THERE

plays.desc_ko: 영혼 드래곤 15초 전, BrokenBlade가 레드 버프 근처에서 Doran을 찾으며 스스로 측면을 노림.
plays.desc_en: Fifteen seconds before soul dragon, BrokenBlade hunts for Doran near red buff while looking for a flank.
plays.quote: Broken blade trying to find Doran around ... He'll look for the flank

plays.desc_ko: Doran이 시야(와드)를 정리.
plays.desc_en: Doran clears wards.
plays.quote: Doran clears out the vision

plays.desc_ko: G2가 Faker에게만 집중하며 교전 시작. Faker가 Justice Punch로 앞으로 나왔다가 순삭(회고: 너무 깊이 들어가 궁을 쓰지도 못함). G2는 드래곤을 빼앗으려 했고 SkewMond는 Peyz에게 풀 진입해 사망, Oner가 처치. BrokenBlade가 E-플래시-Q로 Peyz를 잡고, Labrov는 생존, Keria도 쓰러짐. 'T1 ARE DOWN'.
plays.desc_en: G2 focuses Faker, who Justice Punches in too deep and is deleted without ulting; SkewMond dies to Oner after diving Peyz, BrokenBlade catches Peyz with E-Flash-Q, Keria falls, and Labrov survives.
plays.quote: on Faker ... guard, and Faker's down ... to try and steal THIS AWAY

plays.desc_ko: Doran이 고립되어 G2 4명에게 쫓겼으나 유체화로 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: Isolated and chased by four G2 members, Doran escapes using Ghost.
plays.quote: Doran as well though perhaps caught out ... Four members of G2 trying to chase him ... but he uses the ghost and gets himself

plays.desc_ko: 교전이 G2 쪽으로 기운 뒤 Doran이 2대4 상황에서 플래시로 다시 들어가 몰랑한 빅토르·카르마·애쉬를 추격, 2킬을 따냄. 결국 G2가 Doran을 처치.
plays.desc_en: With the fight tilted toward G2, Doran flashes back in during a 2v4 to chase the squishy Viktor, Karma and Ashe, taking two kills before G2 finally kills him.
plays.quote: He'll take the two ... kill him off in THE END, BUT DORAN evens ... flashes in, gets a couple kills there

plays.desc_ko: Faker가 미드로 이동하는 동안 BrokenBlade가 봇 라인을 밀어 넣음.
plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade shoves the bot lane while Faker rotates mid.
plays.quote: Faker pathing out through mid. Broken ... blade's going to push in bot

plays.desc_ko: 아이템 우위의 BrokenBlade가 Doran을 몰아붙여 체력 우위를 만들고 Doran을 밀어냄. 돌진(charge)이 약간 짧아 곰덫이 빗나가고 Doran의 Undertow 슬로우에 막힘. Doran은 궁을 소모해 버팀('trade of alts').
plays.desc_en: An item-ahead BrokenBlade pressures Doran for a health lead, but his charge falls short, Beartrap misses and Undertow slows him, while Doran burns his ultimate to survive.
plays.quote: Doran ... forced away. The charge in as well by ... misses the bear trap and Undertoe will

plays.desc_ko: Faker가 TP로 합류하고 SkewMond도 탑 라이너를 지키러 옴. Faker는 Justice Punch로 들어갈지 고민하다 물러남.
plays.desc_en: Faker teleports in as SkewMond arrives to protect his top laner, but Faker weighs a Justice Punch engage and backs off.
plays.quote: A TP coming in by Faker ... Steum here to defend his top laner ... No, backs away

plays.desc_ko: G2가 바론을 시작해 획득. 다음 드래곤에 바론 버프를 가지고 임할 수 있게 됨.
plays.desc_en: G2 starts and secures Baron, letting them approach the next dragon with the buff.
plays.quote: G2 now starting the ... G2 get the objective that they ... They get the Baron

plays.desc_ko: T1이 Faker를 넘겨 바론을 견제하려 했고 Doran이 이니시를 노렸으나 BrokenBlade가 탑 쪽에서 Oner를 묶어 둠. T1은 소환사 주문 부족으로 완전한 커밋을 하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: T1 sends Faker over to contest Baron with Doran eyeing an engage, but BrokenBlade ties up Oner topside and T1, short on summoners, doesn't fully commit.
plays.quote: They're trying to get Faker across here ... Doran looking for an ... don't fully commit to it

plays.desc_ko: 바론 중 SkewMond가 Wind Becomes Lightning으로 돌진하고 BrokenBlade가 Faker의 Justice Punch를 막으며 곰덫을 걸었으나 T1 나머지가 지키러 와서 Faker 생존.
plays.desc_en: During Baron, SkewMond dashes in with Wind Becomes Lightning and BrokenBlade blocks Faker's Justice Punch and lands Beartrap, but T1 rushes to save Faker.
plays.quote: dashing forward with becomes lightning ... justice punch blocked by broken blade ... Faker will survive in

plays.desc_ko: T1이 드래곤에 먼저 도착하고 일찍 TP로 합류, SkewMond가 Crescent Guard를 일찍 쓰게 만듦. 영혼 드래곤 대비 진형 구축.
plays.desc_en: T1 arrives at dragon first and teleports in early, forcing an early Crescent Guard from SkewMond as they set up for soul.
plays.quote: T1 first to the ... Teping in early ... has to use the crescent guard early

plays.desc_ko: G2가 앞으로 나서며 교전 시도. BrokenBlade가 Q1으로 Faker에게 돌진, 도발·Justice Punch가 나옴. Oner의 강타가 SkewMond 쪽으로, Oner가 빈사 상태가 되었고 애쉬 화살도 발사. BrokenBlade는 돌진으로 이탈. G2는 리셋을 고민하며 T1을 계속 압박, Faker 도발은 빗나가고 SkewMond는 헤드샷에 저격될 뻔함.
plays.desc_en: G2 steps up as BrokenBlade Q1s onto Faker, drawing Taunt and Justice Punch; Oner smites toward SkewMond and is left near death, Ashe fires an arrow, and G2 keeps pressing as Faker's Taunt misses and SkewMond nearly gets headshot.
plays.quote: G2 might step forward ... Q1 ... OWNER LOW

plays.desc_ko: BrokenBlade가 측면을 위협하며 진입, Keria(자막 'LERA')를 찢고 Oner를 처치. Faker도 빈사로 몰고 'violent tendencies'로 한 명 더 잡으며 재탑승으로 T1을 끌고 다님. 포켓 피스톨처럼 두 명을 더 쓰러뜨림('TAKES DOWN TWO'). 해설: BB가 이 교전에서 3킬.
plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade threatens the flank, shredding Keria and killing Oner, then drags Faker low and remounts to keep dragging T1 around, taking down two more for three kills in the fight.
plays.quote: he was threatening THE FLANK ... ABSOLUTELY EVISCERATES LERA ... BB killed off owner

plays.desc_ko: Doran이 Ragnarok으로 앞으로 나오며 G2 한 명을 처치, Faker의 Hero's Entrance도 적중. SkewMond가 다시 처치됨. Peyz는 BrokenBlade를 쓰러뜨리고 Labrov도 Peyz 화력에 노출되어 헤드샷으로 귀환(사망)당함.
plays.desc_en: Doran surges forward with Ragnarok for a kill and Faker lands Hero's Entrance, SkewMond falls again, Peyz brings down BrokenBlade, and Labrov is sent back by a headshot.
plays.quote: ON THE BACK OF RAGNAR FORWARD AS ALA IS ... Meanwhile, Schumand once again just ... still an advantageous fight for T1

plays.desc_ko: BrokenBlade가 시간을 버는 동안 Caps는 라인을 밀었고, T1(Keria 등)이 Caps를 노렸으나 찾지 못함. Caps는 부쉬에서 헤드샷을 맞고 Keria 궁·애쉬 화살 등 혼전 속에서 수은 장식띠(Mercurial)를 쓰며 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: While BrokenBlade buys time, Caps pushes a wave and evades T1's hunt, taking a bush headshot amid Final Spark and arrows before using Mercurial to escape.
plays.quote: though was broken blade as caps is able ... here they wanted to try to look for caps ... they won't be able to find him

plays.desc_ko: BrokenBlade가 Oner를 추격, Oner는 Cyclone으로 빠지려 함. Oner의 Hero 진입·Q1에 BrokenBlade가 위험해지자 애쉬 화살과 Crescent Guard 넉백으로 지원. Peyz는 원 안으로 들어오지 못하고 BrokenBlade가 수호천사 상태의 Peyz에게 붙음. BrokenBlade는 속박·하차되어 Doran에게서 도망치고 Caps가 킬 획득. 'G2 have found two more'. 회고: 곰덫으로 Oner를 끌어와 처치.
plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade chases Oner and is backed by Ashe's arrow and Crescent Guard's knockback, latches onto a Guardian Angel Peyz, then escapes Doran after being rooted and dismounted as Caps gets a kill, with Oner hooked and killed.
plays.quote: fight and now he's found who has to use ... BB's on his way for the chase ... FROM DORAN AND CAP TAKES THE KILL G2

plays.desc_ko: Peyz가 플래시 없이 귀환/후퇴. 해설은 잡히면 게임이 끝날 수 있는 위험한 움직임이라고 언급.
plays.desc_en: Peyz retreats without Flash, a risky move the casters warn could end the game if caught.
plays.quote: pace is going back but Pace has no flash

plays.desc_ko: 시야에 걸린 G2 선수에게 럭스 바인딩이 맞음. SkewMond로 보이는 선수가 Wind Becomes Lightning과 Crescent Guard 넉백을 쓰고 폭발 열매로 빠져야 하는 상황.
plays.desc_en: Light Binding hits a spotted G2 player, apparently SkewMond, who uses Wind Becomes Lightning and Crescent Guard and needs a Blast Cone to escape.
plays.quote: Spotted. Light bind is going to hit him ... blast cone

plays.desc_ko: 봇 쪽에서 BrokenBlade가 Faker를 쫓아 궁(Charge)으로 Faker의 Hero's Entrance를 끊고 솔로킬. 해설: Faker가 Q 쿨다운만 보고 궁을 잊었고 존야도 쓰지 못함.
plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade chases Faker bot and interrupts Hero's Entrance with Chaaaaaaaarge!!! for the solo kill, as Faker forgot his ultimate and couldn't use Zhonya's.
plays.quote: Faker getting chased out by BB ... CHARGE TO INTERRUPT THE HERO'S ENTRANCE ... Broken Blade gets the solo there

plays.desc_ko: Faker 사망 후 T1이 봇을 대응할 수 없어 영혼을 잃을 것이라는 해설 뒤, G2가 화학공학(Chemtech) 드래곤 영혼과 바론을 보유하게 되었다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: With Faker dead and T1 unable to respond bot, G2 ends up holding Chemtech Dragon Soul and Baron.
plays.quote: to lose soul ... fighting valiantly back into it. A Chem ... Soul and a Baron now for them

plays.desc_ko: T1이 덫 라인을 깔고 Peyz가 앞으로 나와 헤드샷 한 방으로 Caps 체력 70%를 깎음.
plays.desc_en: T1 sets a trap line and Peyz steps up to chunk 70% of Caps' health with one headshot.
plays.quote: T1 set up the trap line ... one head shot on Caps. Lost 70% of his

plays.desc_ko: 피해를 입은 Caps가 귀환 후 TP로 복귀.
plays.desc_en: The damaged Caps recalls and teleports back.
plays.quote: Caps having to reset ... TP coming out from Caps

plays.desc_ko: Doran이 유체화+Ragnarok으로 Caps에게 진입, Keria 궁도 나왔으나 Caps가 플래시로 빠짐. T1은 Caps를 밀어내고 플래시만 빼냄.
plays.desc_en: Doran engages Caps with Ghost and Ragnarok and Keria fires her ultimate, but Caps flashes away, leaving T1 with only zone control and his Flash.
plays.quote: A Ragnarok forward. They'll jump ... CAPS TRIES TO ... GET AWAY. WILL USE THE FLASH

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시점 미드 억제기 포탑이 G2에게 무너짐.
plays.desc_en: Simultaneously, G2 takes the mid inhibitor tower.
plays.quote: INHIBITOR tower in the mid lane will ... fall

plays.desc_ko: 봇 쪽에서 Hans Sama와 Labrov가 바론 버프로 두 번째 억제기 포탑을 밀어 이중 억제기 확보.
plays.desc_en: Hans Sama and Labrov use Baron buff to push the second inhibitor tower in bot, opening a double inhibitor setup.
plays.quote: on the bottom side, Han Sama and the ... Brava pushing forward for a second ... And that's double inhip now there for

plays.desc_ko: G2가 세 라인을 동시에 밀며 T1의 이니시를 크게 두려워하지 않음. 탑 포탑이 무너지고 BrokenBlade가 시선을 끄는 사이 세 번째 억제기까지 파괴(트리플 억제기).
plays.desc_en: G2 pushes all three lanes unafraid of T1's engage, and while BrokenBlade draws attention the top tower falls and the third inhibitor goes down.
plays.quote: take advantage of that by pushing all ... with their engage. Tower in the top lane ... toppled

plays.desc_ko: T1이 탑 쪽에 모여 럭스 궁으로 웨이브를 정리하며 트리플 억제기를 막으려 함.
plays.desc_en: T1 groups top and clears waves with Keria's Final Spark to hold off the triple inhibitor push.
plays.quote: trying to close ranks around top side ... They're going to spend the Lux alult ... make sure that they do not get triple

plays.desc_ko: Keria가 Hans Sama에게 바인딩을 시도했으나 빗나가고, 다시 앞으로 나섰지만 두 개의 이니시 스킬 모두 빗나감. Oner는 밀려나고 Peyz는 피해를 넣으며 수은은 아껴 둠.
plays.desc_en: Keria's binding on Hans Sama misses and both of his follow-up engage skills miss as well, Oner is pushed back, and Peyz deals damage while saving Mercurial.
plays.quote: Carrier looking for the ... light binding. Goes wide of Han Sama ... Carrier steps forward but again between

plays.desc_ko: G2가 미드로 밀고 들어가 Doran을 잡으려 하고 수호천사를 소모시킴. BrokenBlade도 진입했으나 Doran Ragnarok·클레드 돌진 이후 Caps가 사망. SkewMond가 Faker에게 맞진입, Labrov가 헤드샷 피격, Peyz 궁은 Hans Sama가 몸으로 막음.
plays.desc_en: G2 pushes mid to catch Doran and burns his Guardian Angel, but after Ragnarok and Kled's charge Caps dies; SkewMond counter-engages Faker, Labrov eats a headshot, and Hans Sama body-blocks Ace in the Hole.
plays.quote: are just going to push through MID ... guardian angel as G2 TRY AND CATCH ON to ... CAPS IS DOWN

plays.desc_ko: T1이 수비 교전에서 반격. 럭스 바인딩, Peyz의 전진, Faker 합류로 G2를 전멸시킴.
plays.desc_en: T1 strikes back defensively with Light Binding, Peyz pushing forward and Faker joining to wipe G2.
plays.quote: A LIGHT B THEM AS ... AWAY, BUT FAKER IS HERE. T1 are not done ... AS THEY WIPE away G2

plays.desc_ko: T1이 장로 드래곤을 시도해 획득. G2는 이 교전을 받지 않기로 함. SkewMond의 스틸 가능성이 언급되었으나 실제 시도는 서술되지 않음.
plays.desc_en: T1 secures Elder Dragon as G2 declines the fight, with a possible SkewMond steal mentioned but not attempted.
plays.quote: is they're going to try to go for the ... Elder Drake. G2 decide they do not want

plays.desc_ko: 장로와 맞바꿔 G2가 바론 러시. BrokenBlade는 TP로 복귀해 반대편에서 압박하고, SkewMond 혼자 바론을 치는 사이 Caps가 시야를 지킴. BrokenBlade가 진입 각을 보았으나 Peyz·Faker가 수비. 바론은 G2가 획득('Baron for Elder exchange').
plays.desc_en: G2 rushes Baron in exchange for Elder, with SkewMond soloing it while Caps holds vision and BrokenBlade teleports back to pressure the other side, held off by Peyz and Faker, as G2 secures Baron.
plays.quote: tping back and he's going to look for a ... just a Baron rush from G2? I think it ... quick baron. It's only human doing it

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 바론 쪽을 살피며 앞으로 나왔다가 빠른 아이템 효과(자막 'fast autoation')로 발각. 스틸해도 죽는다고 판단해 시도하지 않고 T1은 Peyz 귀환 등 리셋.
plays.desc_en: Oner scouts Baron but is spotted, judges he would die even if he stole it, and T1 resets including Peyz's recall.
plays.quote: Owner's looking as well ... Spotted out by the fast autoation ... Recall coming out from

plays.desc_ko: 장로 버프가 끝나자 G2가 전진. BrokenBlade가 덫 라인을 밟아 하나를 맞고, 거대한 미니언 웨이브를 쌓음.
plays.desc_en: Once Elder expires, G2 advances, with BrokenBlade stepping on one trap while building a huge minion wave.
plays.quote: why G2 feel that they can step further ... Broken Blades going ... to walk over that trap line. Takes one

plays.desc_ko: Doran의 Undertow가 Caps를 둔화, 막히지 않은 Peyz 궁으로 Caps가 체력 절반을 잃음. 럭스 E로도 둔화.
plays.desc_en: Doran's Undertow slows Caps, an unblocked Ace in the Hole takes half his health, and Lucent Singularity slows him further.
plays.quote: Cap slowed with the undertoe ... Caps just lost half ... his health. It looked like an alt snuck

plays.desc_ko: 빅토르 궁(Arcane Storm)에 Peyz가 물러나고, 탑 억제기가 BrokenBlade에게 무너지기 직전.
